# Blocking indefinitely while acquiring advisory lock

The advisory_lock context manager executes SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(:key), which blocks until the lock is acquired and has no timeout behavior in this code. If the lock is held elsewhere, callers will block (potentially indefinitely), which can stall pipelines or workers.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/db.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.db.advisory_lock`
